jobs.title: Trained Undergraduate Teacher (Marathi)
jobs.apply: Applications along with valid Employment Card Registration, Residence Certificate and Academic Qualification Certificates should reach the Headmistress, People's High School, Mala, Panaji – Goa 403001, on or before 13th November 2026, by hand delivery or email to peopleshigh@peopleschool.edu.in
jobs.description: To teach Marathi. Male candidates may also apply. Reservation / Requirement: Out of the posts: 2 OBC/DBC, 1 EWS. TET Clearance is mandatory.
